title: slider intensity grade
name: Slider intensity grade
rule: Slider = intensity/grade (volume, brightness, saturation) when a precise number is not required; pair NumberInput with Slider when precision is required.
pass_when: Slider is used for intensity/grade without a required precise number; precision uses Slider + NumberInput.
fail_when: Slider as the only control when a precise number is required; or slider for a non-intensity discrete choice.
overview: Sliders express intensity or grade when a precise number is not required.
apply_when: Picking a control for volume, brightness, saturation, or similar grade.
not_when: Discrete non-intensity choices better served by radios or select.
agent_hint: Use Slider for intensity; pair NumberInput when a precise value is required.
description: Ant reserves Slider for intensity or grade — volume, brightness, saturation — when users need not enter a precise number. When precision is required, pair NumberInput with the Slider so the grade and the exact value stay in sync. Use this when choosing a control for continuous intensity, not for discrete non-intensity choices better served by radios or select. Fail Slider alone when a precise number is required, or a slider used for a non-intensity discrete choice.
do_not_claim: GOV.UK "don't use range sliders" on question pages as a winner; MUI/Apple number-entry dual-cite as this slider row.
